6Terms & Conditions
  1. Pricing: Prices quoted are in Indian Rupees (INR) and are valid only for the quantities and validity period stated above.
  2. Price Revision: Prices are subject to revision without prior notice in case of changes in raw material cost, currency fluctuation, or statutory levies after the validity period.
  3. Order Confirmation: This quotation shall be treated as confirmed only upon receipt of a written Purchase Order and applicable advance payment.
  4. Part Number Verification: Buyer is requested to verify part numbers, OEM cross-references, and specifications before placing the order; we are not liable for parts ordered against incorrect references supplied by the buyer.
  5. Payment: Payment must be made strictly as per the terms mentioned in this quotation; delayed payments may attract interest at 18% per annum.
  6. Delivery: Delivery schedules mentioned are tentative and commence from the date of order confirmation and receipt of advance, whichever is later.
  7. Freight & Insurance: Unless specified, all dispatches are on FOR basis and transit insurance is to be borne by the buyer.
  8. Warranty: Warranty is limited to manufacturing defects only and excludes damage due to misuse, improper installation, or normal wear and tear.
  9. Inspection: Goods are deemed accepted unless a discrepancy is reported in writing within 48 hours of receipt.
  10. Returns: Goods once sold will not be taken back except for verified manufacturing defects, and only in original packaging.
  11. Liability Limitation: Our liability under this quotation shall not exceed the invoice value of the goods supplied; we shall not be liable for any consequential or indirect loss.
  12. Force Majeure: We shall not be held responsible for delay or non-performance caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to natural calamities, strikes, or transport disruptions.
  13. Jurisdiction: Any dispute arising out of this quotation shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Jaipur, Rajasthan.
  14. Validity: This quotation, if not confirmed within the validity period, stands automatically lapsed and subject to re-confirmation of price and stock.
